        Number of decimal places to keep. Must be >= 0.

    and '?' matches exactly one character.
    Runs in O(len(pattern) * len(s)) time and space using dynamic programming.

            # or one more character: dp[j-1] from current row.
            # We update in-place left-to-right to reuse the same row.

                dp[j] = match and dp[j - 1]
